children: The facility's total commitments grew from $600M by increasing the revolving commitments by $750M and terminating the previous $100M unsecured delayed-draw term loan. The credit facility initially matures in March 2030 and may be extended through two six-month extension options. The credit facility was undrawn at closing.

Borrowings under the credit facility will continue to bear interest at SOFR + 105 basis points based on Janus Living's current leverage-based pricing grid and carry a facility fee on the entire revolving commitment of 15 bps per year.

"The Janus Living platform is further strengthened by a balance sheet positioned for growth, with no outstanding debt and substantial capacity to pursue accretive external growth opportunities that generate long-term value for our shareholders," said Chief Financial Officer Kelvin Moses.
At Thursday's close of $30.23, Janus Living
stock has climbed 51% from its $20 per share IPO price in March.

title: Janus Living closes on upsized $1.25B revolving credit facility
